meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 它会陪你搭文章大纲、查资料并按你选定的格式加引用、改写开头 Hook、逐段给反馈，同时保留你原有的写作风格和语气。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章或技术文档，或需要给草稿加引用、改开头 Hook 时触发。

say.text: 帮我为「AI 对产品管理的影响」列一份文章大纲
say.note: 会先问受众、篇幅和写作目标

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会给出几个改写选项并说明理由

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么这很重要」这一节，帮我看看并给反馈
say.note: 按清晰度、行文、证据、风格逐项提建议

howto.what_en: It works alongside you on a draft: building outlines, researching and adding citations in the format you choose, rewriting hooks, and giving feedback section by section, while keeping your own voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, long-form articles, or technical docs, or when you need help adding citations or improving an opening hook.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI in product management
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length, and goal

say_en.text: Here's my intro. Help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: Returns several rewritten options with reasons

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it
say_en.note: Feedback on clarity, flow, evidence, and style
